title: Toyota Recalls Front Passenger Airbags in Certain Vehicles

body_markdown:
**PLANO, Texas (Nov. 12, 2026)** — Toyota is conducting a voluntary safety recall involving certain Toyota and Lexus vehicles. Approximately 314,000 vehicles are involved in this recall in the U.S.


The front passenger airbag made by Takata contains an inflator with propellant that can degrade over time in certain temperature and humidity conditions. Degraded propellant can cause the inflator to rupture if the airbag deploys. An inflator rupture may cause metal fragments to pass through the airbag and into the vehicle interior at a high speed, which may result in injury or death to vehicle occupants.


For all involved vehicles, Toyota and Lexus dealers will replace the front passenger airbag inflator or replace the airbag assembly, depending on the model, free of charge.


Information about automotive recalls, including but not limited to the list of involved vehicles, is current as of today’s filing date and is subject to change thereafter. To see if your vehicle is involved in a safety recall visit Toyota.com/recall or nhtsa.gov/recalls and enter your Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) or license plate information.


For any additional questions, Toyota customer support is also available by calling the Toyota Brand Engagement Center (1-800-331-4331).
